### Accelerate immunometabolism flow discovery

Get deeper insights from rare cell populations with a unique portfolio of flow-validated antibodies
to 90% of key metabolic enzymes. Drop-in ready for rapid panel expansion.

[Explore the portfolio][1]
button-primary

### SimpleStep Ignite™ ELISA

We’re redefining ELISAs to deliver deeper insights,

with 50x greater sensitivity and up to 35x broader measuring range

[Learn more about our chemiluminescent ELISA kits][2]
button-primary

### Less searching. More progress.

MollAI provides instant, intelligent product recommendations that support confident decision‑making
to move your research forward, faster.

[Chat with MollAI][3]
button-primary

### CiteAb Awards 2026

We’re proud to share that Abcam has been recognized across three categories in the 2026 CiteAb
Awards: **IHC Supplier of the Year – Neuroscience, the Significant Individual Impact Award for Dr.
Will Howat, and Highly Commended – Phospho Antibody Supplier.**

[Read more][4]
button-primary

### Save time by choosing the best tools for your spatial biology research

Access the most-cited IHC-validated antibodies. Tested and trusted by spatial biology experts

[Explore our spatial biology research tools][5]
button-primary

### More choice. Less risk. 4,200+ trial-size antibodies now available.

Your research just got easier. Explore 6,200+ recombinant antibodies in convenient 20 µL trial
sizes. Validate performance before committing and move forward with confidence.

[View all our trial-size antibodies][6]
button-primary

### Lab essentials

Your everyday essentials for less. Get premium quality at exceptional value for seamless workflows.

[Browse all our lab essentials][7]
button-primary

### Alzheimer's imaging, simplified

Find everything you need to move your Alzheimer’s research forward, with antibodies to 95% of core
AD genes validated in imaging applications with human samples.

[Explore our Alzheimer's disease imaging tools][8]
button-primary

Our products are cited more than any other supplier’s, making us a trusted partner across the

Our experts can help streamline your project, from creating tailored solutions all the way through
to troubleshooting.

We offer rapid access to cutting-edge reagents wherever you are, whenever you need them, with
flexible delivery options.

abcam:product-category/elisa-kits
ab113851

DCFDA / H2DCFDA - Cellular ROS Assay Kit

The DCFDA / H2DCFDA - Cellular ROS Assay Kit is a complete, widely cited kit designed to simplify
and accelerate the measurement of reactive oxygen species (ROS) in cell cultures.

[View product][9]
[ab113851]
abcam:product-category/primary-antibodies
ab219650

Anti-PRAME antibody [EPR20330]

Anti-PRAME antibody [EPR20330] is a rabbit recombinant monoclonal antibody used to detect PRAME in
flow cytometry (intra), ICC/IF, IHC-P, IP, and western blot.

[View product][10]
[ab219650]
abcam:product-category/elisa-kits
ab325448

Human IL-6 ELISA Kit, Chemiluminescent

Human IL-6 ELISA Kit is a 55-minute single-wash Chemiluminescent SimpleStep for the rapid
quantification of Human IL-6 with higher sensitivity.

[View product][11]
[ab214030]
abcam:product-category/primary-antibodies
ab290

Anti-GFP antibody

Anti-GFP antibody is a rabbit polyclonal antibody that detects all Aequorea victoria GFP variants,
including RFP, YFP, CFP, and EGFP, across multiple applications and is cited in over 3,360
publications.

[View product][12]

## PeproTech recombinant cytokines and proteins for life science research through clinical
## development

development is constantly growing. Thermo Fisher Scientific acquired PeproTech in 2021 and is now

biological insights and develop cutting-edge cell and gene therapies.

cytokines and growth factors are trusted for quality, consistency, and reliability as well as their
ability to support the RUO-to-GMP transition.

# PeproTech Proteins
────────────────────

## PeproTech recombinant cytokines and proteins for life science research through clinical
## development

The need for high-quality biological materials to support cutting-edge disease research and
development is constantly growing. Thermo Fisher Scientific acquired PeproTech in 2021 and is now
offering their wide portfolio of recombinant proteins under the Gibco brand. Backed by thousands of
peer-reviewed publications and decades of expertise, PeproTech recombinant cytokines and proteins
help life science, biotech, and pharma companies achieve success in their endeavors to discover new
biological insights and develop cutting-edge cell and gene therapies.

Because every step of the production process is expertly managed within, PeproTech recombinant
cytokines and growth factors are trusted for quality, consistency, and reliability as well as their
ability to support the RUO-to-GMP transition.

[Find recombinant proteins][72]

## Clinical development and bioproduction

The development and production of cellular and gene therapies requires the use of well-characterized
ancillary materials produced using GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices). For biotherapeutics
developers looking for a qualified source of recombinant cytokines and growth factors, Gibco
PeproGMP recombinant proteins provide high quality and consistency as well as the documentation you
need. All PeproTech recombinant cytokines are made in-house to maintain rigorous quality control,
which helps you seamlessly convert your cell production process to meet clinical requirements.

PeproGMP cytokines

Based on human sequences and produced in E. coli, PeproGMP cytokines and growth factors are designed
and manufactured to meet rigorous standards for producing advanced therapy medicinal products (ATMP)
for clinical use.

[Learn more about PeproGMP cytokines][73]

##### “We use PeproGMP EGF for ATMP production in clinical trials. Major advantages are good
##### lot-to-lot consistency, a comprehensive CoA for GMP purposes and good product performance.” -
##### Daniela

## Cell biology and disease research

When conducting cell culture, signaling pathway research, protein/antibody assays, or animal
studies, quality and purity are crucial to achieving reliable results. Scientists rely on PeproTech
recombinant cytokines to help them develop and perform cell-based functional assays as well as
sophisticated tumor and other disease models in mice.

## Recombinant cytokines, chemokines, and other RUO proteins

PeproTech research-grade proteins comprise not only cytokines but recombinant growth factors,
chemokines, neurotrophins, proteases, other enzymes, ligands, and receptors. Well-characterized
growth factors are key components in development of organoids as in vitro disease models.

Most PeproTech recombinant proteins are based on native sequences from human, mouse, and rat, and
are produced in bacterial, mammalian, or insect cells. Many PeproTech E. coli–produced proteins are
animal origin–free as they are made without using animal-derived cell culture components or
purification resins.

The PeproTech product line includes RUO recombinant cytokines important for research in:
* [Stem cells][74]
* [3D cell culture models][75]
* [Cancer cell biology][76]
* [Neurobiology][77]
* [Immunology][78]
* [Cardiovascular][79]

With the addition of PeproTech proteins to the portfolio, Thermo Fisher Scientific offers an even
wider variety of recombinant proteins that serve many applications and research areas.

[Browse recombinant proteins by therapeutic research area][80]

### Quality assurance for RUO recombinant cytokines

PeproTech RUO recombinant cytokines and other proteins are subject to a rigorous set of quality
control standards. Our Quality Assurance department verifies that every product passes a prescribed
set of quality control tests.

[ Quality control testing for PeproTech RUO recombinant cytokines ][81]

───────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Authenticity*│Verified by N-terminal sequence analysis, SDS-PAGE and, where possible, by RP-HPLC, 
*              │mass spectrometry, and western blot analyses versus standards.                      
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Biological   │Determined in a relevant in vitro and/or in vivo bioassay.                          
activity**     │                                                                                    
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Endotoxin    │Tested by kinetic LAL (Limulus Amebocyte Lysate) method to ensure the lowest        
contamination**│possible endotoxin levels (<1.0 EU/μg).                                             
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Protein      │Verified by UV spectroscopy, SDS-PAGE and, where possible, by RP-HPLC.              
content**      │                                                                                    
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Purity**     │Verified by SDS-PAGE and, where possible, by RP-HPLC. Minimum purity 95% by         
               │SDS-PAGE.                                                                           
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Sterility**  │All products are sterile filtered through a 0.2-micron filter.                      
───────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[Shop PeproTech RUO recombinant proteins][82]

## PeproTech animal-free cytokines and growth factors

When developing in vitro organoid or in vivo disease models, it is important to reduce the
likelihood that a hidden xenobiotic agent of mammalian origin will contaminate the model and
influence the results. Animal origin–free cytokines and growth factors are popular for this reason.

We go a step further to minimize potential risks that can arise from trace amounts of animal-derived
components. PeproTech animal-free cytokines and growth factors are produced within an animal-free
bioprocessing lab using chemically defined, animal-free components under animal-free conditions.

Produced in E. coli, HEK293, or CHO cells, PeproTech animal-free cytokines and growth factors
maintain favorably high activity and purity compared to corresponding proteins produced using
standard bioproduction techniques. Therefore, life science researchers choose PeproTech animal-free
recombinant cytokines to develop and maintain cellular and animal disease models.

### Quality assurance for animal-free cytokines

PeproTech animal-free recombinant cytokines and growth factors are subject to the same rigorous
standards for identity, purity, protein content, and sterility as those for research-grade proteins.
In addition, they are verified to:
* Exhibit comparable biological activity compared to their RUO counterparts
* Have endotoxin levels <0.1 EU/ug

[Shop PeproTech animal-free recombinant proteins][83]

**Cell Therapy Systems products for each step in your workflow**

Thermo Fisher Scientific offers products for cell therapy development and manufacturing including
GMP-grade reagents, media, and consumables as well as specialized equipment, expertise and support.

[Explore the CTS product portfolio][84]

**Tools and techniques for 3D cell culture models**

From media and growth factors to equipment and instruments, Thermo Fisher Scientific produces a wide
assortment of products as well as protocols and guides to support your 3D cell culture and analysis
efforts.

[Explore organoids, spheroids, and 3D cell culture][85]

With the addition of PeproTech proteins to the portfolio, Thermo Fisher Scientific offers an even
wider variety of recombinant proteins that serve many applications and research areas.

[Browse recombinant proteins by therapeutic research area][80]

### Quality assurance for RUO recombinant cytokines

PeproTech RUO recombinant cytokines and other proteins are subject to a rigorous set of quality
control standards. Our Quality Assurance department verifies that every product passes a prescribed
set of quality control tests.

[ Quality control testing for PeproTech RUO recombinant cytokines ][81]

───────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Authenticity*│Verified by N-terminal sequence analysis, SDS-PAGE and, where possible, by RP-HPLC, 
*              │mass spectrometry, and western blot analyses versus standards.                      
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Biological   │Determined in a relevant in vitro and/or in vivo bioassay.                          
activity**     │                                                                                    
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Endotoxin    │Tested by kinetic LAL (Limulus Amebocyte Lysate) method to ensure the lowest        
contamination**│possible endotoxin levels (<1.0 EU/μg).                                             
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Protein      │Verified by UV spectroscopy, SDS-PAGE and, where possible, by RP-HPLC.              
content**      │                                                                                    
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Purity**     │Verified by SDS-PAGE and, where possible, by RP-HPLC. Minimum purity 95% by         
               │SDS-PAGE.                                                                           
───────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Sterility**  │All products are sterile filtered through a 0.2-micron filter.                      
───────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[Shop PeproTech RUO recombinant proteins][82]

## PeproTech animal-free cytokines and growth factors

When developing in vitro organoid or in vivo disease models, it is important to reduce the
likelihood that a hidden xenobiotic agent of mammalian origin will contaminate the model and
influence the results. Animal origin–free cytokines and growth factors are popular for this reason.

We go a step further to minimize potential risks that can arise from trace amounts of animal-derived
components. PeproTech animal-free cytokines and growth factors are produced within an animal-free
bioprocessing lab using chemically defined, animal-free components under animal-free conditions.

Produced in E. coli, HEK293, or CHO cells, PeproTech animal-free cytokines and growth factors
maintain favorably high activity and purity compared to corresponding proteins produced using
standard bioproduction techniques. Therefore, life science researchers choose PeproTech animal-free
recombinant cytokines to develop and maintain cellular and animal disease models.

### Quality assurance for animal-free cytokines

PeproTech animal-free recombinant cytokines and growth factors are subject to the same rigorous
standards for identity, purity, protein content, and sterility as those for research-grade proteins.
In addition, they are verified to:
* Exhibit comparable biological activity compared to their RUO counterparts
* Have endotoxin levels <0.1 EU/ug

## Delivering Excellence Through Science With Quality, Trust And Innovation.

### APIs

We produce high-quality, reliable APIs like antibiotics, antidiabetics, and anti-inflammatories with
GMP certified plants and global regulatory compliance.

### Intermediates

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Specialty Chemicals

We offer Salicylic Acid, Trimethylamine, Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride,
and Methyl Nicotinate.

### Amines

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Contract Manufacture

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

# Welcome to Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.

**“For The Healthier Humankind”**

The definition of Actiza is “**Active zeal**”. We have an active zeal for a healthier world. Actiza
Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. has become a paradigm in pharmaceutical manufacturing, exporting, and
supplying products that meet international standards. Actiza believes in a systematic approach to
all its endeavours. Hence, we have **WHO, GMP, and ISO accreditations** for our business. India has
been a hub for medical tourism, and now it has become an epicentre for pharmaceutical manufacturing,
alongside the world’s medicinal exporter and supplier of all medicines to create a world that is
healthier and happier. We are proud to represent India as an Indian pharmaceutical manufacturing
company to the world as a pure exporter with a **corporate office in Surat, Gujarat, India.**

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

We distribute 175,567 plasmids on behalf of 6,990 labs from around the world. Our collection also
contains 1,089 ready-to-use viral vectors and 277 recombinant antibodies. These materials have been
requested 2,457,630 times and shipped to 113 countries.

## What's New

### A Fresh Look, The Same Addgene

We've refreshed our brand to better reflect the full scope of what we do: equipping scientists with
the reagents, resources, and support that make sharing possible. Behind the new look is the same
mission — a nonprofit partner scientists trust with their research.

[ Behind the New Look ][263]

## About Addgene

For over 20 years, our nonprofit repository has been making it easier to access useful research
materials and information.

[Discover our mission][264]

Deposit your plasmids or contribute data — we'll handle storage, distribution, and record-keeping,
helping you to share your discoveries with other scientists.

[Deposit plasmids][265] [Contribute data][266]

Request plasmids, antibodies, and ready-to-use viral preparations for your next experiment.

Browse [plasmids][267], [antibodies][268] or [viral preps][269]

Learn something new from our science guides, eBooks, videos, and blog.

[Explore our educational resources][270]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

Welcome to our team, where the vision of the Board, the leadership of the Management team and the
dedication of the operational staff come together. We are not just colleagues, we are the Adragos
family dedicated to making a difference in the CDMO industry.

quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development

reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their

initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

**antibodies-online.com is a provider and direct seller of research reagents that consolidates a
comprehensive portfolio of antibodies, ELISA kits, proteins, immunoassays and additional research
reagents. The platform comprises a broad range of antibodies-online products supported by in-house
component- and assay-level validation, as well as rigorously selected third-party reagents from
trusted external suppliers. Depending on the offering, products are supported either by internal
scientific expertise within the antibodies-online and Rockland group or by validation data and
documentation provided by external partners. All products are available for direct purchase via
antibodies-online.com and are presented with standardized technical data, detailed documentation and
relevant validation content. Worldwide shipping is supported.**

Our product portfolio is designed to support robust, reproducible and scalable protein-level
research workflows across academic, industrial and translational research environments. As a
single-source procurement partner, antibodies-online.com brings together essential reagent
categories under one roof, including monoclonal, polyclonal and recombinant antibodies, recombinant
and native proteins, ELISA kits, immunoassays, sera, lysates and additional laboratory tools.

A central strength of antibodies-online.com is the depth, structure and transparency of product
information. Standardized performance parameters, technical datasheets, application images,
literature references and customer-generated reports provide detailed insight into reagent
performance. Where available, independent validation data and internal scientific review are
incorporated to support informed product evaluation and purchasing decisions, without implying
uniform sourcing or development pathways across the portfolio.

antibodies-online.com enables efficient comparison and selection of reagents based on standardized
technical criteria. This structured data approach supports the targeted identification and
procurement of suitable products for defined experimental workflows and helps researchers navigate
complex choices with greater confidence.

Rely on antibodies-online.com as your reliable source and direct purchasing platform for antibodies,
proteins, immunoassays and related research reagents. By combining internal scientific expertise
with a curated marketplace of third-party products, standardized data presentation and
validation-focused portfolio management, antibodies-online.com supports reproducible protein-level
research workflows.

**Discover our extensive portfolio today and contact our scientific support team for assistance in
selecting and qualifying appropriate products for your research workflows.**

**antibodies-online.com is a provider and direct seller of research reagents that consolidates a
comprehensive portfolio of antibodies, ELISA kits, proteins, immunoassays and additional research
reagents. The platform comprises a broad range of antibodies-online products supported by in-house
component- and assay-level validation, as well as rigorously selected third-party reagents from
trusted external suppliers. Depending on the offering, products are supported either by internal
scientific expertise within the antibodies-online and Rockland group or by validation data and
documentation provided by external partners. All products are available for direct purchase via
antibodies-online.com and are presented with standardized technical data, detailed documentation and
relevant validation content. Worldwide shipping is supported.**

Our product portfolio is designed to support robust, reproducible and scalable protein-level
research workflows across academic, industrial and translational research environments. As a
single-source procurement partner, antibodies-online.com brings together essential reagent
categories under one roof, including monoclonal, polyclonal and recombinant antibodies, recombinant
and native proteins, ELISA kits, immunoassays, sera, lysates and additional laboratory tools.

A central strength of antibodies-online.com is the depth, structure and transparency of product
information. Standardized performance parameters, technical datasheets, application images,
literature references and customer-generated reports provide detailed insight into reagent
performance. Where available, independent validation data and internal scientific review are
incorporated to support informed product evaluation and purchasing decisions, without implying
uniform sourcing or development pathways across the portfolio.

antibodies-online.com enables efficient comparison and selection of reagents based on standardized
technical criteria. This structured data approach supports the targeted identification and
procurement of suitable products for defined experimental workflows and helps researchers navigate
complex choices with greater confidence.

Rely on antibodies-online.com as your reliable source and direct purchasing platform for antibodies,
proteins, immunoassays and related research reagents. By combining internal scientific expertise
with a curated marketplace of third-party products, standardized data presentation and
validation-focused portfolio management, antibodies-online.com supports reproducible protein-level
research workflows.

**Discover our extensive portfolio today and contact our scientific support team for assistance in
selecting and qualifying appropriate products for your research workflows.**

## Advance Your Discovery

Antibody Solutions helps biopharmaceutical companies advance their discovery of better diagnostics
and therapeutics by delivering fit-for-purpose antibodies. Throughout our more than 30-year history,
our clients have come to rely on us for highly specific scientific expertise, rigorous project
management and a unique fee-for-service, pay-as-you-go model that keeps their IP in their hands.

[Learn More About Cellestive][82]
[bigcell 1]

### See What We’re Working On

As scientists to the core, we frequently conduct our own studies and collaborate with fellow
researchers to help advance innovations that deliver safer, more efficacious therapeutics and
diagnostics to society.

[ Read Our Scientific Research ][83]

### Comprehensive Antibody Research & Production Services

Every day, clients approach our team with a target and challenge us to discover an antibody to lead
them there. Whether that involves just a couple of steps or requires multiple, carefully
orchestrated processes, we chart an efficient, budget-smart course toward validated, highly
purified, and reproducible antibodies. 

[ Learn About Our Services ][84]

## Advance Your Discovery

Antibody Solutions helps biopharmaceutical companies advance their discovery of better diagnostics
and therapeutics by delivering fit-for-purpose antibodies. Throughout our more than 30-year history,
our clients have come to rely on us for highly specific scientific expertise, rigorous project
management and a unique fee-for-service, pay-as-you-go model that keeps their IP in their hands.

[Learn More About Cellestive][82]
[bigcell 1]

### See What We’re Working On

As scientists to the core, we frequently conduct our own studies and collaborate with fellow
researchers to help advance innovations that deliver safer, more efficacious therapeutics and
diagnostics to society.

[ Read Our Scientific Research ][83]

### Comprehensive Antibody Research & Production Services

Every day, clients approach our team with a target and challenge us to discover an antibody to lead
them there. Whether that involves just a couple of steps or requires multiple, carefully
orchestrated processes, we chart an efficient, budget-smart course toward validated, highly
purified, and reproducible antibodies.

## [💪 Great momentum at AIRR‑C Meeting VIII: Decoding and Recoding Immunity][88]

June 25, 2026 by [Lorissa Corrie][89]

Thank you to everyone who joined **AIRR‑C Meeting VIII: Decoding and Recoding Immunity** at Yale
University.

The meeting showcased the breadth and energy of the AIRR Community:

**201 in‑person attendees • 31 remote attendees • 5 keynote speakers • 17 invited speakers • 12
contributed talks • 110 research posters • 5 Working Group/Sub‑Committee posters • 22 early‑career
mentors • 70 mentees • 14 sponsors**

A lot of work, a lot of science, and a lot of fun. Thank you all for making this meeting such a
success!

**And now, a few highlights:**

🏆 **Lifetime Service Award**

We are honored to recognize **Andrew Collins**, Honorary Associate Professor at the University of
New South Wales (Sydney, Australia), with the AIRR‑C Lifetime Service Award for his outstanding
contributions to immunology and to the AIRR community.

For over 25 years, Professor Collins’ work has advanced our understanding of antibody genetics and
repertoire biology, while his leadership in AIRR‑C initiatives, including the **AIRR-C Germline
Database Working Group** and **IARC**, has helped shape germline standards.

🗳️ **AIRR‑C Elections**

We are pleased to announce the results of the **AIRR‑C elections** and congratulate the newly
elected members of the Executive Council. These members are joining Christian Busse (current Chair)
and Encarnita Mariotti-Ferrandiz (Past-Chair).
* Chair-elect
  * **Corey Watson. **Associate Professor, Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Genetics,
    University of Louisville School of Medicine (US)
* Additional members

## [Nominate today for AIRR Community Executive Sub-committee Chair-Elect and Members
## Positions!][93]

May 8, 2026 by [Lorissa Corrie][94]

**NOMINATE **[**HERE**][95]

The AIRR Community Executive is encouraging members to submit nominations for the Community’s
leadership!  With each major meeting interval of the AIRR Community elections are held for
leadership positions within the AIRR-C Executive Sub-committee (Executive SC).  This year we are
holding elections prior to our AIRR-C VIII meeting in June 2026.  We are seeking nominations for
Executive SC Chair-Elect and up to three members of Executive SC.

### **Executive SC Description:**

The Executive SC comprises a Chair, a Chair-Elect, a Past Chair, and up to three additional Members
of the AIRR-C. Each term for Chair usually lasts three AIRR-C Meeting intervals. The first interval
is as Chair-Elect, the second as Chair, and the third as Past Chair. In all three intervals, the
Chair serves as a Member of the Executive SC. Members of the Executive SC other than Chair,
Chair-Elect, and Past Chair may serve (if elected) for up to three AIRR-C Meeting intervals as an
Executive SC member.

The Executive SC provides leadership for the AIRR-C by having monthly meetings in which AIRR
Community governance, finances, communications, meetings and other initiatives are discussed.  The
Executive SC receives reports from the AIRR-C Sub-committees and Working Groups, endorses
manuscripts on behalf of the AIRR-C, assists with resolving any disputes within the AIRR-C or its
SCs and WGs, and reviews financial statements from the TAbS Finance and Audit Committee. The
Executive SC determines how the AIRR-C budget is allocated and decides on funding applications or
other awards for AIRR-C members.  

### **Positions for 2026/2028 Election:**
* **Chair-Elect, AIRR-C Executive Sub-committee (1 position):** The Chair-Elect serves as a member
  of the AIRR Community Executive SC until they take over the role of Chair. The Chair of the
  Executive SC provides overall leadership for the AIRR-C and runs monthly meetings with the
  Executive SC.  The Chair drafts proposals regarding governance of the AIRR-C for review by the
  Executive SC and the AIRR-C, drafts letters of support for grant proposals on behalf of the
  Community, oversees endorsement of manuscripts by the AIRR-C, interacts with the AIRR-C Meetings
  and Communications SC’s regarding AIRR-C meetings and initiatives, and promotes the AIRR-C to the
  larger scientific community.  
* **Member, Executive Sub-committee (up to 3 positions): ** Members of the AIRR Community Executive
  SC assist the Chair in carrying out the functions of the Executive SC.

### **Eligibility for Nomination and Voting:  **
* Individuals wishing to be considered for a leadership position in the Executive SC must be an
  official member of the AIRR Community. 
* Nominees must be nominated by an official member of the AIRR Community. 
* Individuals wishing to vote in the 2026/2028 AIRR-C Executive SC Election must be an official
  member of the AIRR Community.
* To sign up to be an official member of the AIRR Community visit
  [https://www.antibodysociety.org/members/][96]).

### **2026/2028 AIRR-C Executive SC Election Timeline:**
* Nominations open for AIRR-C leadership positions: May 1st- May 15th
* Nominees contacted by AIRR-C Executive SC Chair to determine interest and provide short bios and
  statements of interest: May 15th – May 31st
* Voting open: June 1st- June 9th
* Newly elected 2020/2021 Executive SC members announced on the final day of the AIRR-C Meeting: 
  June 11th

#### **NOMINATE **[**HERE**][97]

We are looking forward to active participation by the AIRR Community membership in the nomination
and election process, and we thank you in advance for your qualified nominations. Thank you for your
interest in the AIRR Community.  For further details about the AIRR-C, its Working Groups,
Sub-committees and initiatives, please visit:
[https://www.antibodysociety.org/the-airr-community/][98]

Filed Under: [AIRR Community][99] Tagged With: [Adaptive Immune Receptor Repertoire Community][100]

## [Nominations now open for the Pam Borghardt Community Service Prize 2026][101]

May 8, 2026 by [Lorissa Corrie][102]

**NOMINATE **[**HERE**][103]****

The lifeblood of the AIRR Community is its members who join us, typically on a volunteer and
uncompensated basis, to advance the AIRR Community’s mission to standardize, analyze and share
AIRR-seq data. The Pam Borghardt Community Service Prize recognizes individuals who have contributed
to the AIRR Community in significant and often under-appreciated ways.

In this spirit, we named the prize in honor of **Pam Borghardt**, who was the Executive Director of
the AIRR Community from when it was started in Vancouver in 2015 until the summer of 2025.  Without
Pam there would be no AIRR Community! She kept the Working Groups and Sub-Committees focused,
reminded people of deadlines and to-dos, followed the details and funding for our international
meetings, and just made things happen. In the continuation of her deep support, Pam made a donation
to the AIRR Community. In recognition, we have chosen not only to rename our community prize in her
honour, but also to accompany it with a **USD 1,000 award**, to be used at the recipient’s
discretion.

By honoring Pam Borghardt, we not only recognize her legacy and love for the AIRR Community, but
also remind ourselves of the volunteer spirit that remains the heartbeat of the AIRR Community.

### Activities exemplifying the award criteria include:
* Participating in one or more Working Groups or Sub-Committees
* Mentoring junior or trainee members
* Assisting with organizing meetings, publications, or other communications 
* Contributing to the AIRR Data Commons, e.g. substantial reviewing or data deposits
* Other tasks that, in the opinion of AIRR Community leaders, constitute selfless acts of
  citizenship that reflect our core mission and values

The Pam Borghardt Community Service Prize

## [Nominate today for AIRR Community Executive Sub-committee Chair-Elect and Members
## Positions!][93]

May 8, 2026 by [Lorissa Corrie][94]

**NOMINATE **[**HERE**][95]

The AIRR Community Executive is encouraging members to submit nominations for the Community’s
leadership!  With each major meeting interval of the AIRR Community elections are held for
leadership positions within the AIRR-C Executive Sub-committee (Executive SC).  This year we are
holding elections prior to our AIRR-C VIII meeting in June 2026.  We are seeking nominations for
Executive SC Chair-Elect and up to three members of Executive SC.

### **Executive SC Description:**

The Executive SC comprises a Chair, a Chair-Elect, a Past Chair, and up to three additional Members
of the AIRR-C. Each term for Chair usually lasts three AIRR-C Meeting intervals. The first interval
is as Chair-Elect, the second as Chair, and the third as Past Chair. In all three intervals, the
Chair serves as a Member of the Executive SC. Members of the Executive SC other than Chair,
Chair-Elect, and Past Chair may serve (if elected) for up to three AIRR-C Meeting intervals as an
Executive SC member.

The Executive SC provides leadership for the AIRR-C by having monthly meetings in which AIRR
Community governance, finances, communications, meetings and other initiatives are discussed.  The
Executive SC receives reports from the AIRR-C Sub-committees and Working Groups, endorses
manuscripts on behalf of the AIRR-C, assists with resolving any disputes within the AIRR-C or its
SCs and WGs, and reviews financial statements from the TAbS Finance and Audit Committee. The
Executive SC determines how the AIRR-C budget is allocated and decides on funding applications or
other awards for AIRR-C members.  

### **Positions for 2026/2028 Election:**
* **Chair-Elect, AIRR-C Executive Sub-committee (1 position):** The Chair-Elect serves as a member
  of the AIRR Community Executive SC until they take over the role of Chair. The Chair of the
  Executive SC provides overall leadership for the AIRR-C and runs monthly meetings with the
  Executive SC.  The Chair drafts proposals regarding governance of the AIRR-C for review by the
  Executive SC and the AIRR-C, drafts letters of support for grant proposals on behalf of the
  Community, oversees endorsement of manuscripts by the AIRR-C, interacts with the AIRR-C Meetings
  and Communications SC’s regarding AIRR-C meetings and initiatives, and promotes the AIRR-C to the
  larger scientific community.  
* **Member, Executive Sub-committee (up to 3 positions): ** Members of the AIRR Community Executive
  SC assist the Chair in carrying out the functions of the Executive SC.

### **Eligibility for Nomination and Voting:  **
* Individuals wishing to be considered for a leadership position in the Executive SC must be an
  official member of the AIRR Community. 
* Nominees must be nominated by an official member of the AIRR Community. 
* Individuals wishing to vote in the 2026/2028 AIRR-C Executive SC Election must be an official
  member of the AIRR Community.
* To sign up to be an official member of the AIRR Community visit
  [https://www.antibodysociety.org/members/][96]).

### **2026/2028 AIRR-C Executive SC Election Timeline:**
* Nominations open for AIRR-C leadership positions: May 1st- May 15th
* Nominees contacted by AIRR-C Executive SC Chair to determine interest and provide short bios and
  statements of interest: May 15th – May 31st
* Voting open: June 1st- June 9th
* Newly elected 2020/2021 Executive SC members announced on the final day of the AIRR-C Meeting: 
  June 11th

#### **NOMINATE **[**HERE**][97]

We are looking forward to active participation by the AIRR Community membership in the nomination
and election process, and we thank you in advance for your qualified nominations. Thank you for your
interest in the AIRR Community.  For further details about the AIRR-C, its Working Groups,
Sub-committees and initiatives, please visit:
[https://www.antibodysociety.org/the-airr-community/][98]

## [Nominations now open for the Pam Borghardt Community Service Prize 2026][101]

May 8, 2026 by [Lorissa Corrie][102]

**NOMINATE **[**HERE**][103]****

The lifeblood of the AIRR Community is its members who join us, typically on a volunteer and
uncompensated basis, to advance the AIRR Community’s mission to standardize, analyze and share
AIRR-seq data. The Pam Borghardt Community Service Prize recognizes individuals who have contributed
to the AIRR Community in significant and often under-appreciated ways.

In this spirit, we named the prize in honor of **Pam Borghardt**, who was the Executive Director of
the AIRR Community from when it was started in Vancouver in 2015 until the summer of 2025.  Without
Pam there would be no AIRR Community! She kept the Working Groups and Sub-Committees focused,
reminded people of deadlines and to-dos, followed the details and funding for our international
meetings, and just made things happen. In the continuation of her deep support, Pam made a donation
to the AIRR Community. In recognition, we have chosen not only to rename our community prize in her
honour, but also to accompany it with a **USD 1,000 award**, to be used at the recipient’s
discretion.

By honoring Pam Borghardt, we not only recognize her legacy and love for the AIRR Community, but
also remind ourselves of the volunteer spirit that remains the heartbeat of the AIRR Community.

### Activities exemplifying the award criteria include:
* Participating in one or more Working Groups or Sub-Committees
* Mentoring junior or trainee members
* Assisting with organizing meetings, publications, or other communications 
* Contributing to the AIRR Data Commons, e.g. substantial reviewing or data deposits
* Other tasks that, in the opinion of AIRR Community leaders, constitute selfless acts of
  citizenship that reflect our core mission and values

manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.

guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

commitment to meeting the evolving needs of this dynamic industry and our diverse clientele has
remained steadfast for over three decades. Regardless of your company's size - whether it’s an early
startup or an established multinational corporation - we offer top-tier products of the utmost
quality, underpinned by an unwavering dedication to exceptional customer service.

Today, BiosPacific boasts an extensive portfolio featuring thousands of primary and secondary
antibodies, native and recombinant proteins, and a diverse array of conjugates. While our
specialization lies in cardiac markers, cancer markers, drugs of abuse, thyroid, infectious
diseases, and steroids, our repertoire extends beyond these domains. As part of Bio-Techne, we are
at the forefront of cutting-edge technology driving biomarker discovery. Our hallmark is an
unyielding commitment to exceptional customer service and a non-negotiable standard of quality.
Upheld by a rigorous ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system, BiosPacific assures
adherence to internationally recognized benchmarks. This certification reflects our dedication to
not only supplying outstanding products but also fostering enduring partnerships built on trust,
reliability, and superior performance.

Our proficient and dedicated team stands ready to offer immediate customer support and technical
service to help you identify the best options for your assay development. We eagerly anticipate the
opportunity to serve you and exceed your expectations!

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

Simple sourcing, expert support, and a UK-based team ready to help.

CARBOGEN AMCIS, a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical process development and Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted
photovoltaic system at its Hunzenschwil site in Switzerland. With this project, the company
underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

misleading results from dissolution data alone.

precision cancer treatment.

native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

Entrepreneur India is a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS),
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the most suitable project for investment. It makes
business decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a carefully curated list of the right
projects for investment. Unique among project investment magazines, Entrepreneur India is entirely
dedicated to the business of identifying sound investment projects. Every issue consists of a new
list of ventures that are meticulously selected by the NPCS team after rigorous screening on
multiple investment factors — ensuring that each project recommendation is grounded in real market
opportunity and financial viability.

# Drive Speed and Efficiency in your Early-Stage Drug Development

We give you access to small quantities of licensed molecules from EMA- and FDA-approved medicines
for your R&D.

[ Explore our Shop ][59]
Trusted by global enterprises
[Avacta Logo]
[Homepage]
[Homepage]
[Homepage]

## What we do

[Homepage]

### We buy vials of licensed medicines

As a licensed pharmaceutical wholesaler, we buy FDA/EMA-approved medicines from manufacturers and
authorized wholesalers in the United States and Europe.

[Homepage]

### We aliquot the full-size vials into smaller quantities

The medicines are divided into small aliquots under sterile, aseptic conditions in a laminar flow
environment. The size of the aliquots can vary from 0.02 mg to 500 mg. Our trained laboratory team
ensures reproducibility, precise handling, and full traceability.

[Homepage]

### We store the aliquots until you need them

Aliquots are stored frozen at -70°C in monitored freezers, keeping the molecules viable years beyond
their therapeutic expiration date. They’re ready for analytical and in vitro research when you need
them.

[ Explore our Shop ][60]
[Homepage]

## What makes our approach unique

[Homepage]

### We give you access to the reference medicine

When developing a New Biological Entity (NBE) or biosimilar, accuracy depends on comparing your
investigational molecule to the actual licensed product. With Evidentic, you have access to the
exact reference medicine – same molecule, same formulation.

[Homepage]

### Small Quantities

Avoid paying for full vials when you only need milligrams. Our aliquots preserve the original
concentration and buffer, helping you save on costs without compromising quality.

[Homepage]

### Multiple Batches

Compare your investigational molecule to different batches of the same reference medicine. Getting
access to multiple batches is a challenge through standard channels, but routine at Evidentic. This
enables deeper comparability studies and more robust early results.

[Homepage]

### Fast Shipping

Once qualified, your order ships within days – keeping your project timelines moving forward.

[ Explore our Shop ][61]

## Who we help

[Homepage]

### Biopharmaceutical & Biotechnology Companies

Discover how Evidentic helps you source licensed reference products to support characterization,
stability, and functional studies – without sourcing delays.

[Homepage]

### CROs & CDMOs

See how Evidentic helps you gain access to clinical-grade molecules in original formulations so you
can deliver precise, reliable results for your customers.

[
Learn more
[Homepage]
][63]
[Homepage]

### Biosimilar Researchers

Explore how Evidentic helps you expand your critical quality attribute (CQA) dataset with multiple
batches of the reference product, save on research costs, and accelerate your development timeline.

[
Learn more
[Homepage]
][64]
[Homepage]

### Universities & Research Institutes

Learn how Evidentic helps you secure small quantities of therapeutic-grade molecules to advance your
studies and publish with real-world relevance – all while staying within budget.

Learn more
[Homepage]

Receive a confidential, non-binding quote for the molecule(s) you choose.

## What we do

[Homepage]

### We buy vials of licensed medicines

As a licensed pharmaceutical wholesaler, we buy FDA/EMA-approved medicines from manufacturers and
authorized wholesalers in the United States and Europe.

[Homepage]

### We aliquot the full-size vials into smaller quantities

The medicines are divided into small aliquots under sterile, aseptic conditions in a laminar flow
environment. The size of the aliquots can vary from 0.02 mg to 500 mg. Our trained laboratory team
ensures reproducibility, precise handling, and full traceability.

[Homepage]

### We store the aliquots until you need them

Aliquots are stored frozen at -70°C in monitored freezers, keeping the molecules viable years beyond
their therapeutic expiration date. They’re ready for analytical and in vitro research when you need
them.

[ Explore our Shop ][60]
[Homepage]

## What makes our approach unique

[Homepage]

### We give you access to the reference medicine

When developing a New Biological Entity (NBE) or biosimilar, accuracy depends on comparing your
investigational molecule to the actual licensed product. With Evidentic, you have access to the
exact reference medicine – same molecule, same formulation.

[Homepage]

### Small Quantities

Avoid paying for full vials when you only need milligrams. Our aliquots preserve the original
concentration and buffer, helping you save on costs without compromising quality.

[Homepage]

### Multiple Batches

Compare your investigational molecule to different batches of the same reference medicine. Getting
access to multiple batches is a challenge through standard channels, but routine at Evidentic. This
enables deeper comparability studies and more robust early results.

[Homepage]

### Fast Shipping

Once qualified, your order ships within days – keeping your project timelines moving forward.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries. 

[More about GMP+ International ][52]

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
