orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

### Wide range of innovations; diverse and differentiated product portfolio

[Read More][71]

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

[Read More][72]

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization
by over 65% compared to SOC alone.

# Combining human and machine intelligence to discover the next generation of therapeutic
# antibodies.

Therapeutic Challenge

## Molecule performance is governed by a complex interplay of factors

Complex antibodies, like multispecifics, are hard to engineer because the relationship between
design and function is often non-intuitive. As a consequence, conventional methods are liable to
deliver sub-optimal molecules which either fail in the clinic or result in poor patient outcomes.

Our Solution

## Introducing the EVA™ platform

We’ve developed EVA™ — a highly automated discovery engine that enables the rapid identification and
co-optimisation of complex therapeutic antibodies across multiple key properties. 

[ Learn More ][17]
Therapeutic Impact

## Complete on/off killing selectivity for therapeutic antibodies

Our platform is both modality and format-agnostic but for our internal pipeline, we’re focussed on
the development of selectivity-enhanced antibodies for the treatment of solid tumours. Our novel
approach is delivering a pipeline of antibody therapeutics with best-in-class killing profiles.

indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits

des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

# Celebrating America’s 250th Anniversary

Founded in Brooklyn in 1849, Pfizer has channeled American ambition into generations of
breakthroughs that change patients' lives.

 

[Our History][90]

[Photograph of a woman smiling as a child lifts a toy plane toward the sky.]

#### Pfizer's 2025 Impact Report

Every year, we take stock of the impact our work has on the world, the environment, and people
themselves.

[Read the report][91]

#### diseases. 

[Internal medicine graphical thumbnail portrait image 2]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal.

Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster

scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of

Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

# Life sciences consultancy

## Life Science Commercial Experts

We are a life sciences consultancy specialising in mergers and acquisitions, commercial strategy,
and marketing services for companies in the life sciences and biotech sectors. Our consultants bring
both scientific know-how and commercial expertise to provide consultancy advice and practical help
with implementation.

[Start a conversation][54][Meet our consultants][55]
[biotech strategy consulting team talking to a client]

## How Can We Help You?

Running a life science company brings different challenges depending on where you are in your
journey. Whether you are planning an acquisition, trying to bring structure to your growth, or
struggling to generate consistent marketing material, it can be difficult to know what to prioritise
next. We have worked with companies at each of these stages, both as operators and advisors. 

### Need Strategic Direction for Growth?

As companies grow the decisions around go-to-markets, distributor networks, and product development
become harder.  

Our life sciences consultancy services provide structured, strategy-led support to help you make
informed decisions, align your commercial approach, and plan for long-term growth. 

[→ Explore Consultancy Services][56]

### Need a Marketing Strategy or Design Work? 

Strong science does not always translate into consistent revenue.  Building a strong brand identity
to speak to your customers is key. 

Our life sciences marketing services are focused on positioning, messaging, and execution to help
you connect with your customers.  

[→ Explore Marketing Services][57]

### Planning a Transaction or Exploring Acquisition?

If you are considering acquiring a company, or preparing your business for sale, the process can
quickly become complex.

Our Life Sciences Mergers & Acquisitions team supports buy-side and sell-side projects with
sector-specific insight, access to owner networks, and hands-on transaction support.

[→ Explore M&A Services][58]

## Case Study

From preclinical assets to commercial portfolios, we help biotech companies achieve critical
business milestones: faster time-to-market, lower cost of goods, capital-efficient scale-up, and
maximized exit valuations. Our expertise delivers measurable commercial impact—across every stage of
the development lifecycle.

LEarn More[Contact][59]
* ### 2BScientific – Commercialisation and Marketing Support
  
  The Challenge:
  
  As 2BScientific expanded, the business required a structured commercialisation strategy to support
  growth, strengthen its market position and ensure marketing activity remained aligned with wider
  business objectives.
  
  Our Approach & Outcome:
  
  PSL developed and implemented the company’s commercialisation and marketing strategy, including
  customer targeting, market positioning, content development, digital marketing campaigns and
  growth planning.
  Tim Bernard, CEO of Pivotal Scientific, initially acted as Marketing Director, helping establish
  the company’s commercial foundations before transitioning into a board-level role. PSL continued
  to provide outsourced marketing support, strategic guidance and ongoing commercial oversight as
  the company matured.
  
  The company established a strong presence within the life science distribution sector, building a
  recognised brand supported by a scalable marketing infrastructure. PSL continues to provide
  strategic and tactical marketing support while helping guide the business’s long-term growth
  plans.

## Supporting your Life Science Journey 

As a life science strategy consulting partner, we help more than 100 biotech companies navigate
growth, marketing, commercialisation, and transaction challenges. Whether you need a few hours of
design work, an hour of consultancy advice, optimising your distribution network, or preparing for a
merger or acquisition, we’re here to support you every step of the way with:
1. **Expert Team:** Our consultants have years of experience in the biotech industry.
2. **Global Reach:** We have a network of trusted partners and distributors worldwide.
3. **Proven Success:** We’ve helped numerous biotech companies achieve significant milestones.
4. **Tailored Solutions:** We customize our strategies to meet the specific needs of your business.

[Speak to an expert][60]

## Insights and Tips for Business

Stay updated with our latest blog posts, featuring insights on marketing strategies, comparisons of
various sales channels to discussions on scientific advancements.

# Life sciences consultancy

## Life Science Commercial Experts

We are a life sciences consultancy specialising in mergers and acquisitions, commercial strategy,
and marketing services for companies in the life sciences and biotech sectors. Our consultants bring
both scientific know-how and commercial expertise to provide consultancy advice and practical help
with implementation.

[Start a conversation][54][Meet our consultants][55]
[biotech strategy consulting team talking to a client]

## How Can We Help You?

Running a life science company brings different challenges depending on where you are in your
journey. Whether you are planning an acquisition, trying to bring structure to your growth, or
struggling to generate consistent marketing material, it can be difficult to know what to prioritise
next. We have worked with companies at each of these stages, both as operators and advisors. 

### Need Strategic Direction for Growth?

As companies grow the decisions around go-to-markets, distributor networks, and product development
become harder.  

Our life sciences consultancy services provide structured, strategy-led support to help you make
informed decisions, align your commercial approach, and plan for long-term growth. 

[→ Explore Consultancy Services][56]

### Need a Marketing Strategy or Design Work? 

Strong science does not always translate into consistent revenue.  Building a strong brand identity
to speak to your customers is key. 

Our life sciences marketing services are focused on positioning, messaging, and execution to help
you connect with your customers.  

[→ Explore Marketing Services][57]

### Planning a Transaction or Exploring Acquisition?

If you are considering acquiring a company, or preparing your business for sale, the process can
quickly become complex.

Our Life Sciences Mergers & Acquisitions team supports buy-side and sell-side projects with
sector-specific insight, access to owner networks, and hands-on transaction support.

[→ Explore M&A Services][58]

## Case Study

From preclinical assets to commercial portfolios, we help biotech companies achieve critical
business milestones: faster time-to-market, lower cost of goods, capital-efficient scale-up, and
maximized exit valuations. Our expertise delivers measurable commercial impact—across every stage of
the development lifecycle.

LEarn More[Contact][59]
* ### 2BScientific – Commercialisation and Marketing Support
  
  The Challenge:
  
  As 2BScientific expanded, the business required a structured commercialisation strategy to support
  growth, strengthen its market position and ensure marketing activity remained aligned with wider
  business objectives.
  
  Our Approach & Outcome:
  
  PSL developed and implemented the company’s commercialisation and marketing strategy, including
  customer targeting, market positioning, content development, digital marketing campaigns and
  growth planning.
  Tim Bernard, CEO of Pivotal Scientific, initially acted as Marketing Director, helping establish
  the company’s commercial foundations before transitioning into a board-level role. PSL continued
  to provide outsourced marketing support, strategic guidance and ongoing commercial oversight as
  the company matured.
  
  The company established a strong presence within the life science distribution sector, building a
  recognised brand supported by a scalable marketing infrastructure. PSL continues to provide
  strategic and tactical marketing support while helping guide the business’s long-term growth
  plans.

## Supporting your Life Science Journey 

As a life science strategy consulting partner, we help more than 100 biotech companies navigate
growth, marketing, commercialisation, and transaction challenges. Whether you need a few hours of
design work, an hour of consultancy advice, optimising your distribution network, or preparing for a
merger or acquisition, we’re here to support you every step of the way with:
1. **Expert Team:** Our consultants have years of experience in the biotech industry.
2. **Global Reach:** We have a network of trusted partners and distributors worldwide.
3. **Proven Success:** We’ve helped numerous biotech companies achieve significant milestones.
4. **Tailored Solutions:** We customize our strategies to meet the specific needs of your business.

eliminating antibodies with matrix effects and employing epitope binning and scouting assays, we
ensure the selection of antibodies with optimal binding properties.

purification (mg - grams). We also provide master and working cell bank generation and storage,
antibody stability assays, and determine variable region sequences of antibodies from human and
other animal

## Services We Offer

### [Custom Antibody Services][81]

Novel mono- & polyclonal antibody development in just 30-60 days! Precision Antibody develops Mouse
& Rat monoclonal antibodies, Fully Human monoclonal antibodies, Humanized monoclonal antibodies,
Rat, Rabbit, & Goat polyclonal antibodies. Precision Antibody customizes project strategies to
ensure the delivery of antibodies that work in the intended applications.

### [Antibody Production & Purification][82]

From milligram to gram-scale production, Precision Antibody offers antibody production and
purification from hybridomas, stable cell lines, or transiently transfected cells in serum-free
media, as well as from ascites. Monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies are affinity-purified, buffer
exchanged, concentration adjusted, and delivered in vials to meet your specifications with a
Certificate of Analysis.

### [Antibody Characterization][83]

During an antibody development campaign, the determination of Antibody biochemical and biophysical
characteristics is a necessary step for selecting the best antibodies for an intended application.
The determination of antibody binding characteristics by Octet or Biacore is an integral part of our
antibody development process.

* Cell Banking
* Conjugation
* Stability Assay
* Epitope Mapping

Antibodies play a crucial role across diagnostic, biomarker, and therapeutic fields, with each
application requiring precise development, verification, and validation. Precision Antibody offers
specialized in vivo and in vitro assays to evaluate performance characteristics of selected
antibodies. Service includes:
* Ligand neutralization assays
* Receptor internalization assays
* Various in vitro & in vivo biological assays
* FLOW based assay
* IHC

## Services We Offer

### [Custom Antibody Services][81]

Novel mono- & polyclonal antibody development in just 30-60 days! Precision Antibody develops Mouse
& Rat monoclonal antibodies, Fully Human monoclonal antibodies, Humanized monoclonal antibodies,
Rat, Rabbit, & Goat polyclonal antibodies. Precision Antibody customizes project strategies to
ensure the delivery of antibodies that work in the intended applications.

### [Antibody Production & Purification][82]

From milligram to gram-scale production, Precision Antibody offers antibody production and
purification from hybridomas, stable cell lines, or transiently transfected cells in serum-free
media, as well as from ascites. Monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies are affinity-purified, buffer
exchanged, concentration adjusted, and delivered in vials to meet your specifications with a
Certificate of Analysis.

### [Antibody Characterization][83]

During an antibody development campaign, the determination of Antibody biochemical and biophysical
characteristics is a necessary step for selecting the best antibodies for an intended application.
The determination of antibody binding characteristics by Octet or Biacore is an integral part of our
antibody development process.

### [Other Services][84]

Precision Antibody offers services including:
* Antibody class and subclass determination.
* Isoelectric point determination for monoclonal antibody.
* Detection of oligomers by analytical SEC.
* VH and VL Sequencing.
* Humanization
* Cell Banking
* Conjugation
* Stability Assay
* Epitope Mapping

### [Specialized Services & Assays][85]

Antibodies play a crucial role across diagnostic, biomarker, and therapeutic fields, with each
application requiring precise development, verification, and validation. Precision Antibody offers
specialized in vivo and in vitro assays to evaluate performance characteristics of selected
antibodies. Service includes:
* Ligand neutralization assays
* Receptor internalization assays
* Various in vitro & in vivo biological assays
* FLOW based assay
* IHC
* Custom EIA
* Oncology Panel Profiler

Your research deserves the best. Explore our catalog today to find the antibodies you need for your
research. Take your project to the next level with our premium antibodies and dedicated customer
support.

# Aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für flüssige Produkte von Rommelag

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,

countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Still wondering?

The most common questions, answered plainly.

Is TestWell legit?

Yes. TestWell is a legitimate direct-to-consumer lab testing service that orders blood tests through
Quest Diagnostics and Labcorp — the same accredited national labs that process roughly 70% of all
blood work in the United States. Every order is reviewed and authorized by a licensed physician on
our network before it reaches the lab, and your results come back from the same CLIA-certified
facilities your doctor would use.

Quest Diagnostics and Labcorp — the same accredited national labs that process roughly 70% of all
blood work in the United States. Every order is reviewed and authorized by a licensed physician on
our network before it reaches the lab, and your results come back from the same CLIA-certified
facilities your doctor would use.

How does TestWell work?

You pick a test or panel on test-well.com, answer a few clinical screening questions at checkout,
and pay self-pay. A licensed physician reviews and authorizes the order — usually within minutes —
and we email you a lab requisition. You walk into a Quest or Labcorp location near you (no
appointment needed at most sites), get your blood drawn, and your results land in your TestWell
portal in 1-3 business days.

Do I need a doctor's referral?

No. A licensed physician on the TestWell network reviews and authorizes every order on your behalf,
usually within minutes of checkout. You don't need to schedule a visit, get a referral from your
primary care doctor, or interact with insurance.

What labs does TestWell use?

TestWell uses Quest Diagnostics, Labcorp, and BioReference — the three largest CLIA-certified
national reference labs in the U.S. You choose which lab to use at checkout based on availability
and proximity, and your sample is processed at the same facility your doctor's office would send it
to.

How accurate are TestWell results?

TestWell results are exactly as accurate as the results from your doctor's office, because they come
from the same labs. Quest, Labcorp, and BioReference are CLIA-certified (the federal accreditation
standard for clinical labs) and run the same equipment, calibration, and quality controls regardless
of who ordered the test. The reference ranges shown next to each marker are pulled directly from the
lab's report.

How long do results take?

Most results are ready in 1-3 business days after you visit the lab. Some specialty tests (like food
allergy panels or hormone panels) can take 5-7 business days. You'll get an email and a portal
notification the moment results are released; turnaround time for a given test is shown on its
product page.

How can prices be 80% lower than my doctor's office?

Three reasons. First, we negotiate self-pay rates directly with Quest and Labcorp at scale and pass
them through. Second, we don't bill insurance — that strips out the billing, claims, and denials
overhead that doubles or triples the price of a standard lab test. Third, there are no hospital
markups, facility fees, or doctor's-office overhead because you're going straight to the lab. The
list price you see is the total price.

Can I use my HSA or FSA for TestWell?

Yes. TestWell orders are HSA-eligible and FSA-eligible because they are diagnostic medical tests. We
provide an itemized receipt with each order that meets the documentation requirements for
reimbursement; if your HSA/FSA debit card is rejected at checkout, pay with another card and submit
the receipt for reimbursement.

What states is TestWell available in?

TestWell is available in 49 states plus Washington D.C. and Puerto Rico. Rhode Island is the only
state currently excluded — state law there restricts direct-to-consumer lab ordering, so we cannot
serve patients in RI at this time. Puerto Rico orders are drawn at Quest Diagnostics locations on
the island.

What happens if my results are abnormal?

Every set of results is reviewed by a licensed physician on the TestWell network. If anything is
flagged abnormal or critical, you'll get a clinical note in your portal explaining what the result
means and what next steps to consider. For critical out-of-range values, our medical team contacts
you directly. Abnormal results are not a diagnosis — they're a signal to follow up with your primary
care provider, and you can share the full report with them at any time.

You pick a test or panel on test-well.com, answer a few clinical screening questions at checkout,

Do I need a doctor's referral?

No. A licensed physician on the TestWell network reviews and authorizes every order on your behalf,

TestWell uses Quest Diagnostics, Labcorp, and BioReference — the three largest CLIA-certified

to.

How accurate are TestWell results?

TestWell results are exactly as accurate as the results from your doctor's office, because they come
from the same labs. Quest, Labcorp, and BioReference are CLIA-certified (the federal accreditation
standard for clinical labs) and run the same equipment, calibration, and quality controls regardless
of who ordered the test. The reference ranges shown next to each marker are pulled directly from the
lab's report.

allergy panels or hormone panels) can take 5-7 business days. You'll get an email and a portal
notification the moment results are released; turnaround time for a given test is shown on its
product page.

overhead that doubles or triples the price of a standard lab test. Third, there are no hospital

## About ViroGen

research and diagnostics markets. We're located in Greater Boston, a world center of science and
technology, and were founded in 1995 by scientists from Harvard and M.I.T. Our product offerings are
expanded regularly, and our multilingual staff is prepared to meet the worldwide need for biological
reagents while also providing top-of-the-line contract research services.

At VIROGEN, we make biotechnology work. Let us work for you!

## About ViroGen

research and diagnostics markets. We're located in Greater Boston, a world center of science and
technology, and were founded in 1995 by scientists from Harvard and M.I.T. Our product offerings are
expanded regularly, and our multilingual staff is prepared to meet the worldwide need for biological
reagents while also providing top-of-the-line contract research services.

At VIROGEN, we make biotechnology work. Let us work for you!
